description: Fired when request triage cost and tier classification is completed by dss_optimizer_v2.
Fired when memory loading and requirement analyst checks have populated the design space.
Fired when the architect has completed system design plans.
Fired when the design debate completes with weighted confidence >= 80%.
Fired when the response aggregator compiles specification and critiques into tasks.
Fired when dss_builder_v2 completes coding tasks sequentially.
Fired when integration checks on DTOs, endpoint URLs, and migrations are healthy.
Fired when pytest/Playwright test suites execute without errors.
Fired when a test failure, logic flaw, or parameter sanity check fails.
Fired when recovery analysis compiles a Failure Report and maps a fix loop.
Fired when user validation passes and build is ready for release audits.
Fired when the release manager confirms final build safety.
Fired when user cancels or modifies objectives, resetting FSM to triage.
